title: 第19章 杀杀杀杀的血流成河第20章 天下惊魂密室乱情
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
魔峰下，血染山石。
喊杀声震得天塌地陷。
林云一招逆转局势，杀了三名领袖，活捉凰曦儿。
九大仙宗的联军士气瞬间崩了。
但是这还没完，剩下的几名领袖眼见事不可为。
但是也知道林老魔绝不会就这样放过他们。
所以只能是掀起最终的决战。
然后且战且退。
林云也看穿了他们的目的。
又怎么会如他们的愿。
不过现在他们已经警惕了起来，即使是自己高出一个大境界。
也很难说再次有什么实质性斩获了。
一个一心想要逃命的破虚境大能。
即使是他这样的飞升境大佬，也轻易留不下来。
但是这一群仙道弟子，既然除魔卫道来了。
自然是要留下一些东西的。
这可不是小孩子过家家！
林云站在高塔之上，大手一挥。
阴阳圣宗的护法和弟子们如潮水般冲出
他们嗷嗷叫着，双眼赤红。

早就已经迫不及待的想要饮血了。
被光明正大的打上门围剿，这些天他们的压力可想而知。
要不是林云的威势太强，说不定圣宗早就内乱了。
但是此刻，他们无需压抑自己。
只要掌教魔尊还在，他们就立于不败之地！
只见魔道战旗迎风招展。
无数阴阳圣宗的黑袍弟子犹如潮水不断涌出。
和对面的仙道联军直接碰撞到了一起。
全面的混战拉开帷幕。
仙道那边，剑修们都开始拼命了，无数的飞剑犹如雨点一般落下。
但是圣宗弟子悍不畏死，踏着师兄的的血肉之躯往前不断推进。
各种阵法和合击之术，更是散发着刺目的光芒。
浩然书院的儒生的文道之气冲天而起，无数丹书铁券镇压的圣宗弟子的气势都弱了几分。
但是他们此刻群龙无首，领袖儒青松已死，他们也坚持不了多久了。
大明古刹的合击之术更是化作了无尽金色符文迷惑人的心智。
这样的数百万修士大军的混战。
content_en:
Under the Demon Peak, the rocks are stained with blood.
The shouts of killing shook the sky and the earth.
Lin Yun reversed the situation with one move, killed three leaders and captured Huang Xi'er alive.
The morale of the coalition forces of the Nine Immortal Sects collapsed instantly.
But this was not over yet. The remaining leaders saw that there was nothing they could do.
But he also knew that Old Demon Lin would never let them go like this.
So it can only set off the final decisive battle.
Then fight and retreat.
Lin Yun also saw through their purpose.
How could they fulfill their wish?
But now they are on guard, even if they are a big level above themselves.
It’s hard to say that any substantial gains have been made again.
A Void-Breaking Realm expert who wanted to escape.
Even an Ascension Realm boss like him can't easily stay.
But now that this group of immortal disciples are here to slay demons and defend the Tao.
Naturally, something has to be left behind.
This is not children’s play house!
Lin Yun stood on the tower and waved his hand.
The guardians and disciples of Yin Yang Holy Sect rushed out like a tide
They howled, their eyes red.
I can't wait to drink blood for a long time.
You can imagine the pressure they are under these days, being attacked openly and openly.
If Lin Yun hadn't been so powerful, the Holy Sect might have been in civil strife long ago.
But at this moment, they don't need to suppress themselves.
As long as the Demon Lord is still there, they will be invincible!
I saw the demonic battle flag fluttering in the wind.
Countless black-robed disciples of the Yin-Yang Holy Sect are pouring out like a tidal wave.
They collided directly with the Immortal Alliance forces on the opposite side.
A full-scale melee broke out.
On the side of Immortal Dao, the sword cultivators began to work hard, and countless flying swords fell like raindrops.
However, the disciples of the Holy Sect were not afraid of death and kept pushing forward on the flesh and blood of their senior brother.
Various formations and combined attack techniques emit dazzling light.
The literary and moral aura of the Confucian scholars in Haoran Academy soared to the sky, while the aura of the Holy Sect disciples suppressed by countless alchemy books and iron coupons became a little weaker.
But they are now leaderless, their leader Ru Qingsong is dead, and they can't hold on much longer.
The combined attack technique of the ancient Ming Dynasty turned into endless golden runes to confuse people's minds.
Such a melee of an army of millions of monks.
